title: Compact CLI-first onboarding snapshots and upgrade toolbar for VPC appliance
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: deliver a compact, CLI-first visual asset pack and upgrade-toolbar mockups tailored for Private/VPC appliance onboarding. This ticket covers: 1) a set of 6 compact onboarding tiles optimized for docs and in-console quickstart, CLI-first layout (primary), and GUI fallback (secondary); 2) a step-by-step annotated screenshot set for the appliance installer (headless and GUI modes); 3) progressive-disclosure microstates for the upgrade toolbar (idle, preparing, applying, rollback available, failure + remediation) with small-screen variants; 4) a short 'single-image' hero that can be embedded in the quickstart doc and the console banner; 5) a lightweight A/B test variant that swaps the CLI command emphasis with a 'one-click' copy-to-clipboard action in the console. Acceptance criteria: all assets uploaded to Drive and Figma with export-ready PNG/SVG/PDF; annotated screenshots include CLI commands and expected exit codes; upgrade toolbar states have clear error-to-fix microcopy; accessibility checks (contrast, accessible labels) documented; design handoff notes and asset naming conventions included; engineering receives a condensed spec with breakpoint rules and sprite exports. Deliverables: tile pack (light/dark), installer screenshot series (6 steps), hero image, upgrade-toolbar component mockups (4 states), handoff doc. Prioritization note: this is critical for private launch docs and onboarding conversion; we are prioritizing compactness and copy clarity over heavy illustration to keep image weight small for docs pages.
